metadata.question: Was there more than 12 mg/m^2 of black carbon concentrate at (40.190004, -122.555169) on August 25, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. **Search strategy**: - Collection: MERRA-2 data contains black carbon concentration estimates. I'll use `MODIS/006/MYD04_L2` (MODIS Aqua Aerosol) or MERRA-2 reanalysis data which has black carbon (BC) as a variable. - Actually, MERRA-2 has `MERRA2_400_inst3_3d_aer_Nv` which includes black carbon mass concentration. - Date: August 25, 2020 - Location: Point at (40.190004, -122.555169) - this is near Mount Shasta, California. 2. **Masking strategy**: - MERRA-2 data is already quality-controlled reanalysis data, so minimal masking is needed. - If using MODIS aerosol data, cloud screening may be needed, but MODIS has quality flags. 3. **Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error**: - Check if data exists for the specific date. - Extract the black carbon concentration value for the location. - If value is None/NaN or physically impossible (e.g., negative), output C3. - If value exists and is valid, compare to 12 mg/m³ threshold. - If no data available for that date, output C1. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometry and date const point = ee.Geometry.Point([40.190004, -122.555169]); const date = '2020-08-25'; const startDate = '2020-08-24'; const endDate = '2020-08-26'; // 2. Load MERRA-2 black carbon data // MERRA-2 BC is in kg/m3, need to convert to mg/m3 (multiply by 1e6) const merra2BC = ee.ImageCollection('MERRA2/400/inst3_3d_aer_Nv') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .select('BC'); // Check collection size const collectionSize = merra2BC.size().getInfo(); console.log(`MERRA-2 BC Images found: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log('No MERRA-2 data available for this date.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Get the closest image to the date const bcImage = merra2BC.first(); // 4. Extract black carbon value at the point (convert kg/m3 to mg/m3) const bcValue = bcImage.sample(point, 50000).first().get('BC').getInfo(); // Convert kg/m³ to mg/m³ const bcMgM3 = bcValue * 1e6; console.log(`Date: ${date}`); console.log(`Location: 40.190004, -122.555169`); console.log(`Black Carbon (raw kg/m³): ${bcValue}`); console.log(`Black Carbon (mg/m³): ${bcMgM3.toFixed(4)}`); // 5. Validation and comparison if (bcValue === null || isNaN(bcValue) || bcValue < 0) { console.log('C3'); return; } // 6. Compare to threshold of 12 mg/m³ if (bcMgM3 > 12) { console.log(`Result: ${bcMgM3.toFixed(4)} mg/m³ > 12 mg/m³ threshold`); console.log('A'); } else { console.log(`Result: ${bcMgM3.toFixed(4)} mg/m³ ≤ 12 mg/m³ threshold`); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
